description.value: Little Tea House is a family-run bubble tea shop on Kingsway in Burnaby that has been serving bubble tea and fresh fruit slushies since 1994, claiming to be among North America's first bubble tea establishments. The menu features classic and fruit-infused bubble teas alongside fresh fruit slushies made from high-quality ingredients, prepared with a focus on fresh ingredients and attentive service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at littleteahouse.ca confirms this is a real, operating business at 4700 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 4M1 with phone 604-438-4787, consistent with OSM's city/province tags; the OSM check_date of 2025-05-18 and active website with listed hours both support confirmed-open status. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc. — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The website contains a minor internal inconsistency: the home page states 'Since 1993' while the About page states 'established in 1994'.
concerns: OSM record lacks street address and phone number; full address and phone sourced from website and used in place of OSM values.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café with confirmed address and phone; a viable refreshment stop for cyclists on the Kingsway corridor in Burnaby.
